_about: Chapter 3, rescue at headquarters. This file is the palette block "ch3" (levels pick it with "palette": "ch3").

Look: close to pitch black inside an office tower with the power out, and on its roof. The tower is three levels, one file each: web/levels/ch3.json (ground floor), ch3_2f.json (first floor up) and ch3_roof.json. It starts from the chosen mood (heavy) and changes what that look needs; every difference is explained in the PR description.
Almost nothing shows outside the flashlight beam. The guide colour is the orange of the fuel barrels; red emergency lamps pulse on the walls.
